question: The electrical resistivity ($\rho$) of a metallic conductor is derived using the Drude model of free electrons. According to this model, how is the resistivity related to the relaxation time ($\tau$) and number density of electrons ($n$)?

options.A: $\rho$ is directly proportional to both $n$ and $\tau$.
options.B: $\rho$ is inversely proportional to $n$ and directly proportional to $\tau$.
options.C: $\rho$ is inversely proportional to both $n$ and $\tau$.
options.D: $\rho$ is independent of $\tau$ but inversely proportional to $n$.
